title: Catalin (@catalinmpit) on X
excerpt: It's absolutely fascinating how people are digging themselves an early grave. AI's promise was to allow people to work less and get more done. content_html:
Catalin on X: "It's absolutely fascinating how people are digging themselves an early grave. AI's promise was to allow people to work less and get more done. But now people are working more, feeling more stressed, and lonelier than ever. I see running multiple agents worse than doomscrolling TikTok videos the whole day. Yes, you may get more done with AI, but the constant context switching and trying to follow everything that's happening is more mentally-taxing than everything we've ever experienced. The AI is too fast to keep up with it. Personally, I never run more than 5 agents. More realistically, 3 daily. Even then, 1 agent is the main one and the rest are auxiliary work that I check once in a while. This is the sweet spot for me. If I add more, I start getting dizzy. I'd rather "ship less", than getting burned out and not being able to work months or even years. Anyway, each to their own, but take care of yourself. Nobody does it for you."
